scope.meaningful_reply_definition: A Luca-authored reply that materially advances understanding, clarifies ambiguity, repairs tone, or proposes a next step. Pure greetings, acknowledgements, fillers, and image-only posts are excluded.

dimensions.description: Specific, reality-based communication that clarifies facts or constraints.
Response stays complementary to the incoming work transaction rather than crossing it.
Tone reduces friction and avoids avoidable escalation.
Reply helps the other person decide, act, or move the task forward.
Useful relational repair, reassurance, or acknowledgement when context calls for it.

interpretation_bands.label: strong
interpretation_bands.description: Clear Adult communication with strong practical value.

interpretation_bands.label: solid
interpretation_bands.description: Workable and often helpful, with some room to improve clarity or regulation.

interpretation_bands.label: watch
interpretation_bands.description: Greater risk of friction, ambiguity, or crossed-transaction effects.

ego_states.label: Nurturing Parent
ego_states.description: Supportive, reassuring, easing pressure or repairing tension.

ego_states.label: Adapted Child
ego_states.description: Defensive, avoidant, appeasing, or narrow reactive framing.

transaction_types.label: complementary
transaction_types.description: Reply fits the incoming work transaction and helps the exchange continue productively.

transaction_types.label: crossed_risk
transaction_types.description: Reply introduces a mismatch that may increase misunderstanding or defensiveness.

escalation_labels.label: de-escalating
escalation_labels.description: Likely lowers tension or restores workability.

escalation_labels.label: mild_risk
escalation_labels.description: May raise tension or friction if received poorly.

notes: This config is the versioned source of truth for scoring and scope.
Automation should read this file rather than duplicating rubric constants in code or prompts.
